post.title: 4.2M fewer Black Friday shoppers expected, record spending?
post.ig:
NRF expects 4.2 million fewer Black Friday weekend shoppers than it projected last year.
NRF survey: 182.7 million expected to shop Thanksgiving Day through Cyber Monday, vs. 186.9 million projected in last year's survey (the actual 2025 count came in at 202.9 million).
NRF still forecasts $1.013 trillion in holiday sales, up 4.2%.
Adobe forecasts a record $15.1 billion on Cyber Monday (Nov 30), with $1.09 billion on buy now, pay later.
Sources: National Retail Federation (Nov 19 and Oct 15, 2026), Adobe Digital Insights (Sept 28, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
